notes.title: New Releases Now Available!
notes.notes:
Happy Monday! It's been a busy day today with all these releases, but we hope you're ready for them! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/38e8d15f5049dfd34db64cbe5ddb6f77f32acf86.png[/img]
[h1]First up is I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 1[/h1]
This title has been out for a while over on our site and is now available fully uncensored on Steam! We've also recently updated this title to contain [b]NO MOSAICS[/b]! Those uncensored assets are to [b]die[/b] for huh? (Sorry bad joke, couldn't resist!) It's currently 10% off during launch so we hope you'll check it out! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/4a47290e684969e5f7389a7da1deceb073c8a4a8.png[/img]
[h1]I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 1[/h1]
Yuusuke awakens in a world where zombies have overrun civilization, but finds that the zombies don't attack him. How will Yuusuke take advantage of his new situation, and what will he discover? Enjoy this twist on the classic zombie survival genre.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/942850/I_Walk_Among_Zombies_Vol_1/]Steam[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/c77903020db465c9ad9b360fa6dd01b173a1b664.png[/img]
[h1]Our next release is Hikari! Clover Rescue[/h1]
This is our first third party partner to come to our site! We hope you'll all give them a warm welcome on here and on Denpasoft! This title is also [b]fully uncensored/no mosaics[/b]! Save 40% when you grab your copy today! You can follow Toffer Team on [url=https://twitter.com/TofferTeam]Twitter[/url] or support them on [url=https://www.patreon.com/tofferteam]Patreon![/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/6d4bcc89e9516f1755253191e135659bf56e5ec1.jpg[/img]
[h1]Hikari! Clover Rescue[/h1]
Take on the role as Keigo, a lazy pilot and bounty hunter and stop The Corporation from taking over the world. Save the world, get the girls. All in a hard day's work.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/979330/Hikari_Clover_Rescue/]Steam[/url]

[h1]Now time for some 18+ Adult Only Content DLCs![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/9de32ea0301aee873edc534af790aaa15e509294.png[/img]
Are you ready to play strip the witch? Now you can play Re;Lord 1 with all the erotic scenes directly through Steam! We even have a video on the main game store page showing off the strip battle tactics~
[b]*Please note you must own the base game on Steam to use this DLC. This DLC also contains mosaics over the genitals.[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/d1de0282ffedd130a59e115615004a15e3a76438.png[/img]
[h1]Re;Lord 1 ~The witch of Herfort and stuffed animals~[/h1]
In a fantasy world where magic exists, the demon realm faced an unprecedented danger. Three "witches of disaster" appeared and invaded the demon country of Saarland. Due to the recent peaceful times, Saarland lacked the skills to protect the territory of Groesen.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/788050/ReLord_1_The_witch_of_Herfort_and_stuffed_animals/]Steam (base game)[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/990830/ReLord_1__18_Adult_Only_Content/]Adult Only DLC[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/b1b601b25b729483ad6fedb829a7ee5708809a79.png[/img]
And for our last 18+ DLC release we have NEKOPARA Vol. 1-3! These DLCs will let you [strike]dote up a cat[/strike], I mean, spend some loving bonding time with your cats. Yes. Loving Nekos.
[b]*Please note you must own the base game on Steam to use these DLCs. These DLCs also contains mosaics over the genitals.[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/8cfb49649947dc82166821f4d8f31b288dd0aa6a.png[/img]
[h1]NEKOPARA Vol. 1[/h1]
What's NEKOPARA? Why, it's a cat paradise! Kashou Minaduki, the son of a long line of Japanese confection makers moved out to open his own shop "La Soleil" as a patisserie.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/333600/NEKOPARA_Vol_1/]Steam (base game)[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/947650/NEKOPARA_Vol1__18_Adult_Only_Content/]Adult Only DLC[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/e0b7fae3c2278758fdce2f1cbda942eb0641a605.png[/img]
[h1]NEKOPARA Vol. 2[/h1]
Business is booming for La Soleil, the patisserie run by Kashou Minaduki with his two catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, his sister Shigure, and the Minaduki family's four catgirl sisters.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/420110/NEKOPARA_Vol_2/]Steam (base game)[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/947660/NEKOPARA_Vol2__18_Adult_Only_Content/]Adult Only DLC[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/fa16f93255513848b21b9cd10c8bf4cbe7ea7cdd.png[/img]
[h1]NEKOPARA Vol. 3[/h1]
Patisserie "La Soleil", run by Kashou Minaduki, is flourishing thanks to the help of two catgirls: Maple, full of pride and a little on the haughty side, and Cinnamon, an impulsive daydreamer.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/602520/NEKOPARA_Vol_3/]Steam (base game)[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/947670/NEKOPARA_Vol3__18_Adult_Only_Content/]Adult Only DLC[/url]

[h1]But wait there's one more announcement...[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/652b15fd3244be4f3547ccd05a1df00183ad2356.png[/img]
We're bringing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/834150/Glare1more/]Glare1more[/url] from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Kurenaibook]Kurenaibook[/url] to Denpasoft this Friday! 
Please see our latest blog on [url=https://denpasoft.com/blogs/news/glare1more-coming-to-denpasoft-this-friday]Denpasoft[/url] for more details~
